papers.abstractEn: Driving video captured through a windshield violates the world-space consistency assumed by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS): the road scene exhibits parallax while cabin reflections remain attached to the camera, causing standard 3DGS to embed reflected content into the reconstructed scene. We introduce RIDE-Splat, a pipeline for reflection-free 3D reconstruction from posed driving video without clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks. RIDE-Splat assigns world-consistent transmission through the windshield to a 3DGS scene and the dominant camera-attached reflection to one shared, signed RGB image. It builds the clean reconstruction in two passes. First, it learns the 3D geometry and the signed reflection image, representing both added radiance and transmission attenuation. Then, it uses the reflection-removed training images to fit a clean 3DGS model. At inference, the reflection image is discarded, preserving the standard 3DGS rendering path. We also introduce the RIDE-Splat Dataset, the first 3D reconstruction benchmark for reflection removal from driving video -- with real driving scenes, physical windshield reflections in training views, and separately captured non-reflective evaluation images. Across the RIDE-Splat Dataset, XLD, and Wayve, RIDE-Splat outperforms 3DGS, DC-Gaussian, and RobustSplat on all nine aggregate metrics, improving PSNR by up to 3.59 dB and reducing LPIPS by up to 0.0876. We achieve the highest metrics in 38 out of 42 per-scene comparisons and removes windshield reflections that remain visible in the baselines while preserving the transmitted scene.

classification.tldr: 该论文提出针对驾驶视频的反射去除3D重建方法，将挡风玻璃反射建模为共享签名RGB图像，并在首个相关基准上显著优于现有3D高斯泼溅方法。

papers.title: RIDE-Splat: Reflection Removal for In-the-Wild Driving Environments

papers.abstractEn: Spatio-temporal graph neural networks combine a node's history with information from graph neighbors. The central question is whether graph neighbors provide predictive information beyond each node's own history. Forecast accuracy depends on both the choice of neighbors and the way graph messages enter the temporal model. We study these choices as graph construction and graph exposure on U.S. state unemployment, traffic speed, and electricity demand. Our diagnostic design uses two comparisons: varying exposure while holding the domain graph fixed, and varying construction while holding late gated integration fixed. A GRU using only each node's own history and randomized graph controls help assess what the graph contributes. Under a common change forecasting protocol, the same domain graph can improve or worsen error relative to the GRU across integration designs. Late integration alone is insufficient, while adding a fusion gate yields lower mean error in all three tasks. With late gated integration fixed, a graph based on residual correlations has the lowest mean error among the tested graphs, although randomized graphs perform similarly on unemployment. The findings support evaluating graph construction and integration together, with conclusions tied to the comparisons actually performed.

classification.tldr: 该研究系统评估了时空预测中图构建方式与图信息融合方式对精度的影响，发现带融合门的晚集成与残差相关性图总体误差最低。

papers.title: How Much Graph Is Too Much? Graph Construction and Exposure in Spatio-Temporal Forecasting

papers.abstractEn: A central limitation of modern machine learning systems is the lack of formal certificates guaranteeing their behavior beyond empirical, sample-based evaluation. Sum-of-squares (SOS) methods provide such guarantees by certifying polynomial inequalities over continuous domains via semidefinite programming (SDP). While prior work has introduced SDP layers as differentiable components in neural networks, repeated learning calls can lose the computational benefit of the forward program's sparse representation. We propose Sparse SOS Layers, differentiable value layers whose backward passes reuse the local coordinates of the forward solve. Under a fixed template and learned objective coefficients, each layer avoids building dense certificates and reuses its sparse structure across training steps. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves up to 2.7 times speedup in total warm-call time, with nearly 100 times lower memory usage (1.7 vs. 160 GiB) for relatively large problem sizes for the tested dense parameterization. Experiments cover sparse polynomial certification, pendulum control, combinatorial relaxations, robotics projection, oscillator chains, and pose graph synchronization. A design study achieves zero certified violations across unseen problem instances and sizes, while requiring roughly 7 times fewer optimization solves than estimating gradients by perturbing the objective coefficients and re-solving the problem (finite differences). These results show that sparse certificate values can be effectively integrated into learning pipelines when the backward pass respects the verifier's structure.

classification.tldr: 提出稀疏平方和可微分层，复用前向半定规划的稀疏结构加速反向计算，在多项证书任务上实现最高2.7倍加速与近百倍内存节省。

papers.title: Sparse Sum-of-Squares Layers for Certified Learning

papers.abstractEn: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

classification.tldr: 面向工程师的大语言模型科普综述，以通俗语言介绍Transformer、预训练、微调、RAG、智能体及评测要点等基础概念。

papers.title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers

papers.abstractEn: Kernel techniques are among the most powerful methods in data science and statistics. One of the key properties of kernels contributing to their numerous successful applications is that the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is expressive enough to encode probability distributions without loss of information or to capture the joint independence of $M\ge 2$ random variables, under mild conditions. Computationally, these measures (i) rely on the so-called Gram matrix which contains the pairwise similarity of sample points, and (ii) converge at a rate $O \left(n^{-\frac{1}{2}}\right)$, where $n$ denotes the sample size. We focus on measuring the independence of latent position random graphs (LPRGs), a model widely-applied for instance in neuroscience, sociology, and epidemiology. In LPRGs a latent representation is associated to each node. The similarity of these representations (meant via a kernel) determines whether two nodes are connected, making the Gram matrices only implicitly observable and the estimation challenging. Despite the fundamental importance of quantifying the independence of $M$ LPRGs, very little is known about the solution of this problem; existing techniques are restricted to $M=2$ components and only guarantee consistency without rates. In this work, (i) we define an independence measure called graph Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion (GHSIC) for $M\ge 2$ LPRGs, (ii) we prove that it can be estimated at a rate $\tilde{O}\left(n^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)$ relying on spectral decomposition of adjacency matrices, (iii) without the need to choose kernels and their hyperparameters. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GHSIC estimator both on synthetic examples and in the analysis of brain functional connectivity subnetworks in natural language perception.

classification.tldr: 该文提出GHSIC独立性度量，可对多个潜位置随机图进行联合独立性检验，给出谱分解下的估计速率且无需人工选择核函数。

papers.title: Joint Independence Testing for Latent Position Random Graphs

papers.abstractEn: Semantic communication is emerging as a pivotal paradigm to overcome wireless resource scarcity in 6G networks. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end framework for semantics-aware resource allocation in multi-user Edge AI. We extend the Opportunistic Information Bottleneck (OIB) to a multi-view setting, termed the Multi-view Gaussian Information Bottleneck (MGIB), by fusing complementary source views without variational approximation or network retraining. A resource allocation framework is then formulated for joint compression-level selection, transmission mode selection (i.e., the number of active sources per group), and PRB assignment. The problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP), solved efficiently via a proposed Lagrangian Relaxation (LR) algorithm, and benchmarked against the NP-hard optimal solution. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed LR scheme achieves near-optimal utility, and doubles PRB efficiency versus average allocation.

classification.tldr: 该文面向边缘AI提出多视图高斯信息瓶颈的语义感知资源分配框架，将问题建模为混合整数线性规划并用拉格朗日松弛算法求得近优解。

papers.title: Multi-view Semantic-aware Resource Allocation for Edge AI

papers.abstractEn: Reinforcement learning commonly exhibits non-monotonic performance dynamics in single-task settings. During learning, a sequence of policies is generated whose true performance is unknown and may oscillate significantly across iterations. Despite this well-known phenomenon, standard experimental practice typically reports either the final visited policy or the best among periodically evaluated ones, implicitly assuming that these selection criteria reliably approximate the best-performing policy visited throughout the entire sequence. In this work, we present an empirical study on the implications of non-monotonicity for policy selection in single-task policy-based reinforcement learning. We introduce post-hoc diagnostic metrics to characterize performance degradation and assess the accuracy and efficiency of different selection criteria. These metrics allow us to evaluate commonly used selection strategies across standard continuous-control benchmarks using a well-established on-policy actor-critic method. Our results show that, in this representative experimental setting, widely adopted selection practices can deviate considerably from the best policy encountered during learning, leading to underperforming estimates and suboptimal use of computational resources. As an alternative, we recommend a validation-based policy selection strategy constrained by computational cost, which provides a more consistent and accurate approximation of the best visited policy while improving selection efficiency. Overall, our findings highlight policy selection as an underexplored factor in the evaluation protocols of reinforcement learning and motivate further study on explicit and standardized validation-based selection procedures.

classification.tldr: 该文实证研究强化学习中策略性能非单调性对策略选择的影响，提出事后诊断指标并推荐一种计算受限的验证式策略选择策略。

papers.title: Best Policy Tracking in Reinforcement Learning

papers.abstractEn: The Voynich manuscript is a fifteenth-century book in a script that no one can read. One account holds that its text means nothing and that a scribe made it by copying his own words and changing them a little. The other holds that a real language lies hidden behind a cipher. We write each account as a program that fills the pages of the manuscript, fit every program with the same budget, and check it on statistics the fit never saw. The copying process of Timm and Schinner predicts these statistics far better than any cipher with one key. But ciphers that switch keys between the manuscript's two dialects, or that encode only the word classes of a real text, predict them equally well. Word statistics alone cannot decide. We look for a trace of language that needs no decipherment. In 28 texts in 16 languages the same word pairs keep sharing a line. The manuscript shows this pattern at half the strength of the weakest of these texts. A word code keeps the pattern above the manuscript unless its plaintext has a weak pattern or many words are miscopied. Solvers that decipher control texts find no readable text in the manuscript under a letter cipher, a word code or 28 codes with one letter, letter pair or syllable per word. Word codes of abbreviated Latin, the plaintext their fits prefer, show which word follows which more clearly than the manuscript unless two words in five are miscopied. One cipher remains possible, a nomenclator with a second key whose scribe miscopies more than half of the words, and our solvers cannot exclude it in 9 of 16 languages. Most of the structure a solver finds comes from how the end of one word shapes the start of the next, which reflects how tightly glyphs are bound to each other. Planted messages are found reliably only when they are long, each letter always becomes the same word and these words are adjacent, so other messages could hide.

classification.tldr: 论文通过拟合成因假说程序、校准统计检验和自动破译求解器系统分析伏尼契手稿，发现其几乎不具语言结构特征，仅剩一种高错误率双重密码仍无法排除。

papers.title: Does the Voynich Manuscript Mean Anything? Calibrated Tests Find Little Trace of Language

papers.abstractEn: The recent data and AI regulations and governance needs have highlighted the need for removing specific data even from models trained on or with them. While retraining the entire model is a theoretically trivial solution, it is computationally expensive, thereby motivating research in Machine Unlearning. This paper introduces a robust approximate unlearning technique for the family of prototype-based classifiers called Generalized Learning Vector Quantization, aimed at removal of effects of specified samples, either due to deletion request or due to them being identified as noisy or corrupt. We first show the impact of the different sizes of the forget set, as well as the characteristics of the data in this set, on the unlearned model. To address the sources of instabilities detected in this unlearning method we propose an adapted version of this technique, such that the unlearning is robust to the characteristics of the forget set. Thereafter using the intrinsic interpretability property of GLVQ and appropriate metrics defined in unlearning literature, we show the efficacy (approximately 0 deviation of parameters and performance of unlearned model relative to retrained model) and efficiency (6X for smallest dataset to 10^(5)X in the largest dataset) of the proposed unlearning techniques compared to naive retrained, on six benchmark datasets for tabular data recommended by literature. Although in this work we investigated only binary class problems, the proposed robust unlearning strategy can be readily applied for removing sample effects from any trained GLVQ model, i.e., it does not require any modification in the training scheme of GLVQ.

classification.tldr: 该文针对原型分类器GLVQ提出一种鲁棒的近似机器遗忘方法，能稳定移除指定样本影响，性能接近重训模型且提速数个量级。

papers.title: Approximate Unlearning in Prototype-based-classifiers

papers.abstractEn: A scalar measurement can determine a robust decision without identifying the latent covariance or every decision risk. We study finite Gaussian projection experiments with a fixed mean-plus-standard-deviation target. The observation laws define a set of indistinguishable moment models. We exhibit decisions that agree throughout that set despite unidentified risk values, and give a confidence-set certificate that returns a decision or an unresolved outcome. We prove soundness, necessary abstention for indistinguishable models with incompatible optima, and a fixed-checkpoint certification guarantee. A scalar profile reduces nonlinear risk comparisons to convex inner problems. Across seven synthetic instances, jointly calibrated moment regions give sufficient budgets 21 to 52 times explicit expected-sample information lower bounds. Separately measured stopping times are lower, with zero decision errors in 1,900 simulated streams. These comparisons do not constitute matching bounds, and the guarantees require Gaussian replication.

classification.tldr: 该文提出基于高斯投影观测的鲁棒决策认证框架，给出置信集证书与放弃机制，并在合成实验中实现零决策错误。

papers.title: Certifying Distributionally Robust Decisions from Projection Observations

papers.abstractEn: We present LatentLieODE, a novel neural ODE method to discover linear Lie symmetries and first integrals of the learned dynamics from timeseries observations such as video inputs. It starts with an autoencoder, which learns a low dimensional representation of the observed system and then maps trajectories to decorrelated latent coordinates $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$. A bank of linear infinitesimal generators $\mathbf{A}_k \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ is fitted jointly against a differentiable Lie-bracket residual $\mathbf{J}_f(z)\mathbf{A}z - \mathbf{A} f(z)$, while an MLP optimises the latent ODE $f(z) = \mathrm{d}z/\mathrm{d}t$ to reconstruct the observation-space timeseries. After suitable generators and $f$ are found, we fit a third network $H_φ$ to generate the first integral of the system. Across six benchmark systems (harmonic oscillator, simple and twin pendulums, Lotka-Volterra, pixel pendulum, sphere geodesics) we find each system's relevant symmetries, and the discovered invariants match ground-truth conserved quantities at $|ρ| \geq 0.978$. On the sphere, the pipeline recovers a non-abelian $\mathfrak{so}(3)$, certified by the negative-definite Killing form of its recovered structure constants. This work presents significant advances in data-driven discovery of symmetries and provides a new pathway for neural surrogates of dynamical systems.

classification.tldr: 该研究提出基于神经ODE的LatentLieODE方法，从时间序列观测中自动发现动力系统的李对称性和首次积分，在六个基准系统上恢复的不变量与真实守恒量高度吻合。

papers.title: Data-driven Discovery of Lie Symmetries and First Integrals with Latent ODEs

papers.abstractEn: We study inverse and consensus analysis for PROMETHEE II ranking problems when the performance table is fixed. Existing approaches in PROMETHEE-based sensitivity and consensus analysis usually focus on deviations of criteria weights while treating preference functions as fixed. Nevertheless both sets of parameters jointly determine the outranking flow scores. We introduce a linear reparametrization of the PROMETHEE II net flow scores based on weighted preference increments over the observed differences of performances. This representation yields a linear expression of the net flows and clarifies how weights and preference functions interact. Building on this result, we derive linear optimization models for three settings: minimizing weight deviations while allowing preference functions to vary; minimizing deviations over the full set of preference parameters; and multiple decision-maker consensus analysis (with objectives based either on total deviation or on the maximal individual deviation to promote fairness). An illustrative example shows that allowing preference functions to vary can dramatically change the inverse-analysis conclusions obtained from weight-only models, and that the proposed group formulations distinguish efficient consensuses from fairer ones.

classification.tldr: 针对PROMETHEE II群决策问题提出净流分数的线性重参数化，建立涵盖权重与偏好函数联合变化的多目标线性优化模型。

papers.title: From Outranking Flow Scores to Linear Programs: Group Decision Making in PROMETHEE II

papers.abstractEn: Predicting dynamics across bifurcations by extrapolating trained models is crucial in diverse fields of physics. Generalized synchronization provides a framework for understanding dynamical reconstruction by neural networks, especially in the context of reservoir computing. Building on this framework, we derive a formula combining pretrained readouts to reconstruct unseen chaotic dynamics. Using classical Lagrange interpolation theory, we derive rigorous bounds on readout errors and conjugacy residuals. Numerical examples demonstrate accurate prediction of chaotic dynamics across bifurcations.

classification.tldr: 基于广义同步理论推导组合预训练读出层的公式，给出误差严格界，实现对跨越分岔的混沌动力学的外推预测。

papers.title: Extrapolating learned dynamics across bifurcations based on generalized synchronization

papers.abstractEn: Passive matching networks are critical components in radio-frequency integrated circuits (RFICs), but their design is bottlenecked by expensive finite-difference-based electromagnetic (EM) simulation. We propose an end-to-end neural framework for free-form RFIC passives that predicts both EM response and downstream design performance under varying frequency and circuit contexts, combining a frequency-conditioned neural simulator with a circuit-conditioned neural solver. To improve design performance prediction, the simulator outputs a neural EM response consisting of both the explicit EM response and a complementary response, together with a dependence regularizer that encourages the two responses to capture orthogonal information. To evaluate the proposed framework, we construct a large-scale dataset of free-form passive layouts, synthesized from both expert-designed contours and random paths. Our 21M-parameter model achieves high accuracy across a broad frequency range, circuit contexts and passive matching settings, with $R^2>0.98$ for almost all targets, while providing orders-of-magnitude faster evaluation than traditional EM simulation. Code available at https://github.com/ETH-IDEAS/RFIC-NeuralSim.

classification.tldr: 提出端到端神经网络框架同时预测RFIC无源器件的电磁响应与设计性能，并构建大规模版图数据集，评估速度较传统电磁仿真提升数个数量级。

papers.title: End-to-End Neural Modeling of EM Response and Design Performance for Free-Form RFIC Passives

papers.abstractEn: We analyze stochastic mirror descent for minimizing a convex objective expressed as an expectation under the stationary distribution of a Markov chain, using noisy subgradient observations along a single sample path. Through Poisson's equation, we decompose the Markovian noise and control its contribution under regularity and moment conditions that allow the stochastic subgradients and the Poisson solution to be unbounded across the state space. We establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ bound on the expected suboptimality gap of the weighted-average iterate for an appropriately chosen step size. The analysis does not require aperiodicity or convergence of the chain's marginal distributions to stationarity. For irreducible finite-state chains, we verify the required conditions on the Poisson solution and derive explicit bounds that quantify the effect of periodicity. For irreducible countable-state chains, we verify the required regularity and moment conditions under a geometric Lyapunov drift condition and suitable growth bounds on the stochastic subgradients.

classification.tldr: 分析马尔可夫噪声下允许无界次梯度的随机镜像下降，通过Poisson方程分解噪声，在无遍历性假设下对加权平均迭代建立O(T^-1/2)的次优性界。

papers.title: Non-Ergodic Markovian Mirror Descent with Unbounded Noise

papers.abstractEn: Time-series forecasting models typically use a fixed decoding strategy at inference time: either one-shot prediction of the full horizon or autoregressive rollout over atomic chunks. While one-shot decoding reduces error accumulation, it can discard useful sequential structure; conversely, autoregressive decoding preserves temporal dependencies but may compound errors. We argue that the optimal decoding strategy is not fixed across inputs, but should be selected adaptively for each forecasting instance. We propose a dynamic strategy selector that treats the forecast rollout schedule as an inference-time decision problem for frozen pretrained time-series foundation models. The selector is a learned network that ranks candidate rollout schedules using hidden states of the backbone, and is trained on historical windows of the evaluated tasks for each backbone. To make the candidate set tractable over the exponentially large space of horizon partitions, we use dynamic programming that reduces candidate evaluation to quadratic complexity while preserving much of the oracle gain. At deployment, five independently trained selectors vote on each decision, and the policy follows their consensus, falling back to the backbone's one-shot forecast where they disagree. The construction requires only the backbone's hidden states and lightweight selectors, with no fine-tuning of the forecasting backbone. On fev-bench with a frozen Chronos-2 backbone, agreement-gated selection improves point-forecast skill (MASE) over one-shot decoding with statistical significance, mostly on longer horizons. It recovers about 6-8% of the gain that the same dynamic program attains with ground-truth selection. With a frozen Moirai-1.1-R-small backbone, the improvement is also significant on the full benchmark, and for both backbones we claim gains in point accuracy only.

classification.tldr: 针对冻结的时间序列基础模型提出动态解码策略选择器，用动态规划压缩候选预测调度并经多选择器投票，在fev-bench上显著优于固定的一次性解码。

papers.title: Dynamic Multi-Step Decoding for Time-Series Foundation Models

papers.abstractEn: We consider multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization without assuming bounded iterates or coercivity of the original objective. We propose the Controlled Block Proximal Linearized (CBPL) method, which incorporates a control potential into block updates while retaining the original objective, variables, and constraints. Under explicit control design conditions and the KL property, the control yields boundedness, finite length, whole-sequence convergence of the original variables, and convergence of objective values. At the limit, one limiting subgradient of the original objective vanishes on all effective comparison directions. We apply CBPL to graph-regularized nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF), CP decomposition, and independent-core matrix tri-factorization (NMTF) with $\ell_0$ norm sparsity constraints. We characterize their reconstruction-preserving scale degeneracies, proving that scale criticality is equivalent to graph collapse and that full criticality forces such collapse. Explicit controls provide compact sublevel sets and a uniform positive lower bound on graph action, including with an independent Tucker core, while retaining genuine reconstruction-changing directions. Each block admits an explicit projection and a computable safe step parameter. For ordinary NMF and CP models, whole-sequence convergence to a full critical point follows. Experiments with direct safe updates demonstrate convergence, sustained graph action, and controlled factor and core scales.

classification.tldr: 提出一种带控制势的块近端线性化方法，在非凸非光滑多块优化中实现全序列收敛，并应用于NMF、CP分解等模型的尺度退化分析与安全步长设计。

papers.title: Controlled Block Proximal Linearized Method for Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization

papers.abstractEn: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.

classification.tldr: 该文提出一种无需插值的虚拟格架算子用于乳腺X光图像梯度特征提取，在保持敏感度的同时降低计算与存储开销并提升疾病分类效果。

papers.title: A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis

papers.abstractEn: With the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), software developers are presented with a powerful new approach: delegating software development tasks to LLMs. Existing studies have explored task delegation for a subset of tasks and factors. Critically, what tasks developers delegate to LLMs, to what extent, and why they delegate them, is not yet well understood. We explore these questions through 22 interviews and a survey with 160 software practitioners. Developers reported employing four modes of task delegation to LLMs: full delegation, partial delegation, self-delegation, and task avoidance. Drawing on our qualitative findings, we discuss the rationales behind these choices and explore how task difficulty, task risk, developer motivation, and trust appear to be associated with software development task delegation to LLMs. Our statistical analysis reveals that trust is a significant factor associated with task delegation to LLMs. Finally, we share actionable implications for human-AI collaboration in software research, and for software practitioners to make the most of their newly found powers of delegation.

classification.tldr: 通过22次访谈和160人问卷研究开发者向LLM委派任务的四种模式,发现信任程度是影响委派行为的关键因素。

papers.title: Developer Task Delegation to LLMs and the Trust Factor: A Mixed Methods Study

papers.abstractEn: Multi-Agent Path Planning (MAPP) requires collision-free paths for multiple agents. MAPP has numerous real-life applications, including the navigation of automated vehicles, and has therefore many variants considering different constraints, requirements, and objectives. For each such variant, a new algorithmic treatment is often developed. This paper takes a complementary, specification-centered view: we show that many MAPP variants can be modeled in HyperLTL, a temporal logic that reasons about multiple paths and their evolution through time, and in its omega-regular extension HyperQPTL. The contribution is not a claim that current hyperproperty model checkers replace specialized MAPP solvers. Rather, the hyper-logical view gives a unified language for comparing MAPP variants, adding cross-agent constraints, expressing optimality, and connecting MAPP to verification, explanation, and causality techniques for hyperproperties.

classification.tldr: 用HyperLTL超性质时序逻辑为多智能体路径规划提供统一规约语言，可表达跨智能体约束并连接验证与因果性技术。

papers.title: A Hyper-Logical View on Multi-Agent Path Planning

papers.abstractEn: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

classification.tldr: 对从BERT到GPT-5的大模型发展进行系统分类综述，梳理数据、算力与架构演进，指出架构复杂度与数据质量的平衡规律。

papers.title: Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design

papers.abstractEn: Symbolic music representations encode musical content at varying levels of completeness, from performance-oriented formats such as MIDI to fully notated scores such as MusicXML. Yet the impact of this representational richness on deep learning models remains poorly understood. While tokenisation has been extensively studied for MIDI, score-based formats have received considerably less attention, and MusicXML in particular remains largely unexplored despite being the de-facto standard for score interchange. In this paper, we introduce the first general-purpose tokenisation framework for MusicXML, and conduct a systematic empirical study to determine whether notational richness confers a measurable advantage for deep learning on symbolic music. We train 26 autoregressive and masked language models, comparing MusicXML tokenisation against MIDI and ABC-based representations, probing the effect of different tokenisation strategies within MusicXML, and testing whether music-grammar-aware tokenisation outperforms treating scores as plain text. We evaluate music understanding tasks using linear probing across composer classification, difficulty estimation, and accompaniment suggestion, and generative tasks using objective statistical metrics and a human pairwise preference study. Our results show that MusicXML-tokenised models outperform MIDI and text-based counterparts on understanding and generative tasks.

classification.tldr: 提出首个通用MusicXML分词框架，系统实验证明乐谱记号的丰富表示在音乐理解与生成任务上优于MIDI和纯文本方案。

papers.title: Does Notation Matter? MusicXML Tokenisation for Symbolic Music Generation and Understanding

papers.abstractEn: Deep graph generators (DGGs) largely lack interpretability, which is a significant limitation for one of their most crucial applications, drug discovery, where interpretable and transparent generation could provide greater control over the desirability of generated molecules, thereby reducing trial-and-error in candidate selection. Common approaches to interpretability, such as disentanglement, cannot guarantee that the learned representations are human-interpretable. To address this, we propose incorporating concept bottlenecks into DGGs, allowing users to interpret, debug, and steer the generation process. We show that this consistently improves distributional fidelity (lower FCD), with only modest, non-systematic effects on validity and uniqueness. We further explore Concept Controller, an optimization-based steering approach that has proven to be effective for steerable image generation. We evaluate our approach on a one-shot molecular graph generation framework, though the underlying ideas can be transferred to sequential graph generation as well.

classification.tldr: 将概念瓶颈引入深度图生成模型，使分子生成过程可解释、可调试并可由用户操控，同时提升分布保真度。

papers.title: Interpretable and Steerable Molecular Graph Generation using Concept Bottlenecks

papers.abstractEn: Generative machine learning provides an end-to-end framework for aerodynamic design optimization by generating diverse aerodynamic configurations conditioned on target performance. However, the generated designs may violate geometric constraints or deviate from the prescribed aerodynamic performance. Therefore, we propose a Condition-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network (CEGAN) that embeds geometric and aerodynamic information into the generative process. A condition-informed loss function is developed by combining a geometry-guided feasibility penalty with an aerodynamic performance penalty evaluated by surrogate models trained on the same dataset. Additionally, an output filtering mechanism discards infeasible designs using these surrogate models, ensuring compliance with prescribed conditions. The method is demonstrated on aircraft configurations similar to the Cessna Citation X. Each configuration is represented by 28 shape parameters, whose aerodynamic performance is evaluated using OpenVSP. Interpolation and extrapolation tests are conducted for different network architectures and conditioning strategies. Compared with the baseline model, CEGAN reduces the average generation error by at least 36% for interpolated conditions and by at least 46% under extreme extrapolation conditions, while successfully producing diverse and physically feasible designs that extend beyond the training distribution. Therefore, the proposed CEGAN framework offers a robust and accurate tool for rapid aerodynamic configuration exploration during the conceptual design phase.

classification.tldr: 该研究提出条件增强生成对抗网络，将几何与气动约束嵌入生成过程并配合代理模型过滤，用于商用飞机气动构型设计，显著降低生成误差并产出可行且多样的设计。

papers.title: Condition-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Configuration Design of Commercial Aircraft

papers.abstractEn: Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan's (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

classification.tldr: 这篇词汇学综述区分了语料式与受控实验式合成语言数据两类，论证合成数据是独立的语言学研究对象并强调其解释需考虑生成条件。

papers.title: Synthetic linguistic data

papers.abstractEn: Time Series Foundation Models have demonstrated that pretraining on diverse datasets enables effective transfer to new forecasting tasks. Classical methods like ARIMA, however, remain configured and trained independently for each series, discarding knowledge from previous experiments. Consequently, selecting and training an ARIMA configuration remains challenging and often relies on heuristic approaches based on in-sample goodnessof-fit measures. We propose MetaARIMA, a pretrained configuration policy based on metalearning that brings transfer learning to classical statistical forecasting at the configuration level rather than the model level. The policy learns from historical experiments which ARIMA configurations achieve top-quantile performance, and recommends promising candidates for new series while preserving interpretability and local estimation. At inference, it selects a diverse set of candidates via maximal marginal relevance and efficiently identifies the final configuration using successive halving. Experiments in a transfer learning setting, training on M4 and evaluating on M1, M3, and Tourism, show that MetaARIMA outperforms AutoARIMA and other classical methods while being more dataefficient. In a comparison with recent zero-shot foundation models, MetaARIMA remains competitive with Chronos2, Moirai2, and TimesFM. The experiments are publicly available at https://github.com/vcerqueira/experiments-metaarima.

classification.tldr: 该研究提出基于元学习的ARIMA配置迁移策略，通过历史实验预训练推荐高表现配置，在跨数据集预测任务中优于AutoARIMA并媲美零样本基础模型。

papers.title: MetaARIMA: Configuration-Level Transfer Learning for ARIMA Models

papers.abstractEn: Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in industrial applications, but their performance gradually degrades over time, making accurate lifetime prediction important for safety and reliability. However, reliable lifetime assessment generally requires extensive degradation testing, which is both costly and time-consuming. To reduce this burden, recent data-driven approaches have sought to predict the end-of-life cycle of batteries from only the initial few cycles. Nevertheless, identifying reliable degradation patterns from such limited early-cycle data remains challenging because early aging dynamics are often subtle and nonlinear. To address this issue, we adopt the continuous wavelet transform to convert cycle-wise voltage, current, and capacity signals into time-frequency representations, enabling multi-resolution characterization of degradation behavior. Building on this representation, we apply scale compression to reduce redundancy while preserving structural information in the scalograms. We evaluate the proposed framework on eight benchmark datasets derived from seven public battery datasets covering diverse electrode chemistries, cell form factors, and cycling protocols. Experimental results show that the proposed framework consistently outperforms prior approaches in single-cycle remaining useful life prediction and remains robust as the number of input cycles increases from 1 to 100. In addition, redundancy-fidelity analysis characterizes the trade-off introduced by scale compression, and gradient-based visual explanations indicate that the model focuses on localized time-frequency regions associated with structured signal transitions during charge-discharge operation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed framework for early-cycle battery remaining useful life prediction.

classification.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于连续小波变换与尺度压缩的深度学习框架，仅用单循环早期数据即可准确预测锂离子电池的剩余使用寿命。

papers.title: Single-Cycle Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Compressed Continuous Wavelet Features and Deep Neural Networks

papers.abstractEn: When events resume after a long silence, explicit Gaussian point-process filters amplify the first update exponentially in the silence duration. We give the exact distribution of this update and a computable index that predicts when it overshoots. For the explicit (single-scoring-step) filter and its implicit posterior-mode counterpart, we derive second-order silence expansions of the state variance with opposite-sign logarithmic corrections. The crossing index determines when the post-wake prediction exceeds the resumed rate, separating the bin width at which the amplification exponent reaches one from the larger width at which the true rate is overshot. At fixed bin width, the implicit filter's expected loss grows logarithmically with silence duration, whereas a continuous-time counterexample rules out a bound uniform in bin width and silence duration. Experimental evaluation confirms these predictions in all 73 crossing cells and on exchange trade data, while variance caps reduce explicit overshoot but mostly hurt the implicit filter.

classification.tldr: 该论文对显式高斯点过程滤波器在长静默后恢复事件时的指数级更新过冲给出精确分布与可计算的越界指标，并用理论和实验验证预测。

papers.title: Exponential Wake-Up Overshoot in Explicit Gaussian Point-Process Filters

papers.abstractEn: We study the minimax regret rate for episodic kernel-based reinforcement learning, where the expected reward and transition density belong to a Sobolev reproducing kernel Hilbert space, with continuous state and action spaces, and adversarial initial states. For Sobolev smoothness parameter $ν>0$, state dimension $d_S$, and action dimension $d_A$, we prove that the minimax expected regret over $T$ episodes is $\widetildeΘ(T^{\max\{e_A,e_B\}})$, where $e_A=\frac{ν+d_A}{2ν+d_A}$, $e_B=\frac{ν+d_A+3d_S/2}{2ν+d_A+2d_S}$ with the other model parameters fixed. The two exponents reflect the distinct difficulties of action selection and learning across states. We introduce Sobolev Optimal Value Iteration (SOVI), which attains this rate from observed rewards and transitions. For fixed smoothness and reference-kernel lengthscale, its regret bound has a prefactor polynomial in the state-action dimension $d=d_S+d_A$, horizon $H$, transition and reward RKHS norm bounds $u,B_r$, and kernel norm-comparison factor $Λ$, up to logarithmic factors. The algorithm separates initial action selection from continuation-value estimation and combines local polynomial approximation with the shared RKHS structure of the approximation errors. Our matching upper and lower bounds determine the optimal dependence on the number of episodes for Sobolev kernel-based reinforcement learning. Thus, we partially address the open problem in Vakili(2024) under the condition of the Sobolev kernel setup.

classification.tldr: 在Sobolev核函数RKHS假设下推导了回合式核强化学习的极小极大遗憾率，提出达到该率的SOVI算法并给出匹配上下界。

papers.title: Minimax Regret for Sobolev Kernel-Based Reinforcement Learning

papers.abstractEn: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is essential for assessing decision policies before deployment when online experimentation is costly or unsafe. Accurate estimation remains difficult when behavior-policy data are limited and the target policy favors states and actions rarely observed in those data. We propose InCOPE, a prior-data fitted network that learns a shared policy-value prediction rule across synthetic OPE tasks. We construct an OPE task prior over Markov decision processes and behavior-target policy pairs, generating behavior-policy datasets and exact target-policy values for pretraining. For a new tabular decision problem, the pretrained network uses the behavior-policy dataset, target policy, and known task settings as context to predict the policy's expected return without task-specific parameter updates. Experiments across four tabular domains, including a semi-synthetic clinical setting, demonstrate InCOPE's effectiveness for policy-value estimation.

classification.tldr: 该文提出InCOPE，通过在合成离线策略评估任务先验上预训练先验数据拟合网络，实现无需参数更新的上下文内策略价值估计。

papers.title: Prior-Data Fitted Networks for In-Context Off-Policy Evaluation

papers.abstractEn: Accurate CSI forecasting is essential for mitigating channel aging and supporting reliable downlink transmission in high-mobility wireless systems. In FDD systems, forecasting future DL CSI from historical UL observations requires joint temporal extrapolation and cross-band inference. However, defining historical UL as the input and future DL as the target does not specify how elapsed time and UL-to-DL band separation should be represented in a pretrained predictor's positional space. FAR-CSI establishes an FDD-aware representation of channel forecasting within a joint temporal and operating-band positional field. Within this field, historical UL observations and future DL targets occupy segregated regions according to their temporal and operating-band roles, preserving the distinction between observed UL context and unobserved DL prediction targets. This representation is instantiated through a unified structured routing rule that governs encoder positional assignment, decoder-field reconstruction, and future-DL target selection, ensuring the same FDD geometry is preserved from contextual encoding to prediction readout. Under matched backbone, initialization, and training conditions, FDD-aware routing reduces NMSE by 21.44\% relative to generic routing. Across the evaluated FDD baselines, FAR-CSI achieves higher CSI prediction accuracy and MRT-based spectral efficiency, while retaining its predictive advantage across mobility conditions, prediction horizons, reduced training-data regimes, and noisy historical observations.

classification.tldr: 提出面向FDD系统的信道预测结构化时空-频带位置表示方法，统一编码器、解码器和目标选择的路由规则，显著降低预测误差。

papers.title: Structured Time-Frequency Representation for Channel Prediction

papers.abstractEn: Prosthetic and assistive interfaces increasingly depend on decoding hand gestures from surface electromyography (sEMG). Because the signal is shaped by person-specific factors, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) commonly used to model these temporal streams must adapt to new wearers and new gesture classes after deployment. Continual learning (CL) enables this adaptation without retraining from scratch, yet applying it to recurrent sEMG models is not straightforward. Standard recurrent training practices can destabilize learning, and which CL strategy holds up under realistic cross-user drift is unestablished. We evaluate three representative CL strategies under domain- and class-incremental drift on NinaPro DB1, and find experience replay to outperform elastic weight consolidation (EWC) and naive fine-tuning. It reaches 83.3% final accuracy for class-incremental drift while limiting forgetting to 1.8-5.8% accuracy drop, as against 16.2-28.5% for EWC and naive training. We further show these models must be trained on shuffled, independently-windowed segments. Streaming windows in temporal order collapses the network into predicting a single dominant gesture, while a shuffled, stateless regime trains stably. Finally, hand-crafted time-domain features raise per-task accuracy by up to about 40% over raw signals, but only replay preserves that gain under class-incremental drift.

classification.tldr: 该文系统评估了三种持续学习策略在跨用户sEMG手势识别漂移下的表现，发现经验回放显著优于EWC和朴素微调，并证明乱序无状态训练是稳定训练的关键。

papers.title: Cross-User Adaptation for sEMG Gesture Recognition via Continual Learning

papers.abstractEn: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. The G-layer enforces geometric quality assurance (GQA) via a mapping f: Theta -> Q from the statistical parameter space to a physically interpretable quality domain, employing a cosine similarity gate to retain minority updates based on physical geometry rather than statistical proximity. The T-layer executes topological Pareto control, identifying a sensitivity-based knee point (lambda_k) to balance multi-objective aggregation without majority degradation. Finally, the H-layer operationalizes a cognitive twin dynamic to mirror the user's real-time psychological state, dynamically adapting human-computer interaction modes via active intent alignment. To ground this theoretical architecture empirically, we validated the S-G-T core on a binational synthetic clinical network simulation. This proof-of-concept demonstrated a "zero-sum escape": a minority node (<3% data volume) achieved utility parity (loss reduction from 0.857 to 0.340) alongside dominant hubs. Our Fed-Universe framework is being expanded along two focused pillars: institutional multimodal alignment (Fed-Ultra) and individual cognitive intent alignment (Fed-Human).

classification.tldr: 提出Fed-Universe联邦学习架构，通过语义、几何、拓扑和认知四层机制将被动平均转为主动协商式对齐，在跨站点异质场景下使少数节点达到与主导节点相当的性能。

papers.title: Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems

papers.abstractEn: With the rapid development of modern scientific research, tensor data have become increasingly prevalent across a wide range of fields. How to effectively characterize the relationship between tensor predictors and a response while preserving the intrinsic structure of tensor data has therefore become an important problem in high-dimensional statistical analysis. Existing tensor regression methods mainly focus on conditional means or conditional quantiles. When the response distribution is asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or contaminated by outlying observations, the conditional modal provides a robust and interpretable alternative characterization. In this paper, we propose a partial modal tensor regression (PMTR) method. The proposed method constructs the partial modal tensor covariance, which incorporates information on the conditional modal to guide tensor dimension reduction, and subsequently establishes a modal tensor regression model in the reduced tensor space. This strategy alleviates the dimensionality burden caused by direct vectorization while preserving the intrinsic structural information of tensor predictors. Under suitable regularity conditions, we establish the consistency and asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators and employ a data-driven dimension-selection procedure to determine the effective dimension along each tensor mode.

classification.tldr: 提出部分模态张量回归方法，利用条件模态信息指导张量降维并保留结构信息，适用于非对称、重尾或含离群点的响应分布，并给出估计量的一致性与渐近性质。

papers.title: Partial Modal Tensor Regression

papers.abstractEn: We propose a causal machine learning framework to integrate dynamic tolling for mobility, equity, and climate objectives, resolving a long-standing policy trilemma. Using Double Machine Learning, we estimate zone-type-specific treatment effects, showing that commercial zones yield nearly twice the delay reduction of residential zones. Our adaptive quota mechanism expands residential coverage 34-fold while preserving 93% of total delay savings and sustaining high return on investment. The framework delivers climate co-benefits, reducing emissions by 743.5 metric tons of CO2 (valued at 141 USD) via congestion-sensitive pricing under moderate traffic conditions with sensitivity bounds from 557.6 to 929.3 tons. Crucially, we uncover a policy-invariant toll range where performance remains robust across demand scenarios, simplifying implementation. This study reveals critical, previously unidentified insights, such as a policy-invariant toll range, that can significantly simplify real-world implementation. Validated on synthetic data mirroring real-world networks, our methodological advances lay the foundation for future public deployment.

classification.tldr: 提出基于双重机器学习的因果框架来设计动态收费政策，同时优化通行效率、公平与减排目标，并在合成路网上验证了自适应配额机制与政策不变收费区间的稳健性。

papers.title: Resolving the Mobility-Equity-Emissions Trilemma: A Causal Machine Learning Framework for Dynamic Tolling Policy

papers.abstractEn: Gradient equilibrium (GEQ) is a recent framework in online learning that requires the time-averaged gradients along the learner's trajectory to vanish. We study GEQ when the learner is constrained and ask when such an equilibrium remains achievable in an adversarial environment. We first show that constrained GEQ (CGEQ) can be impossible even under simple and slowly varying constraints, motivating imposing local temporal structure on the adversary. We then develop an approachability framework for CGEQ under locally constrained adversaries, and obtain necessary and sufficient characterizations in the spirit of classical Blackwell approachability. Beyond these theoretical characterizations, we provide an algorithmic principle that converts window-wise no-regret learners into CGEQ algorithms under a local feasibility condition with margin. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate that the resulting algorithms perform strongly in both achieving GEQ and respecting the constraints.

classification.tldr: 研究带约束的梯度均衡在线学习问题，证明其在简单约束下可能不可达，并在局部受限对手下建立可达性理论刻画，给出将无遗憾学习器转化为约束算法的构造方法。

papers.title: Constrained Gradient Equilibrium: Approachability under Locally Constrained Adversaries

papers.abstractEn: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are trained to sample objects from compositional spaces with probability proportional to a reward function, but ineffective exploration can cause learned samplers to concentrate on a few high-reward regions. An intuitive remedy is to train multiple GFlowNets independently in parallel and combine their samples. However, this does not prevent multiple models from collapsing onto the same high-reward areas, leaving large regions of the state space unexplored. With this in mind, we propose Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets (HCG), an approach that dynamically partitions the search space to coordinate discovery without relying on hand-crafted boundaries. HCG imposes an ordering in which the highest-ranked model may explore the entire space, while lower-ranked models are progressively pushed toward regions not covered by higher-ranked ones. We provide a theoretical characterization of how specific learning objectives can shift probability mass away from designated areas, instantiating this mechanism within our architecture. A shared classifier coordinates the hierarchy by partitioning the search space, keeping the GFlowNets independently parameterized and enabling asynchronous training. Furthermore, we derive a normalizer-weighted aggregation rule for the ensemble and prove that it recovers the target reward-proportional distribution under the stated assumptions. Finally, experiments across multimodal distributions, sequence generation, combinatorial optimization, and biological sequence design show that HCG improves mode coverage and target approximation, translating increases in the number of coordinated samplers into broader, complementary exploration.

classification.tldr: 提出层次化协作GFlowNets框架，通过动态划分搜索空间协调多个采样器，避免模型坍缩到同一高奖励区域，理论上证明聚合后可恢复目标分布，并在多模态分布和序列设计等任务上提升模式覆盖。

papers.title: Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets

papers.abstractEn: We propose a joint sparse sample weighting and parameter estimation (SWAPE) framework that jointly optimizes model parameters and sample weights to train a model while simultaneously assigning an individual weight to each training data point. Our framework accommodates several widely used loss functions for the model parameters, including convex, weakly convex, and difference-of-convex loss, and weakly convex sparsity functions to control the complexity of the sample weights. To solve the resulting bivariate problem, we propose an alternating minimization method in which the subproblems for updating the model parameters and weights are each approximated using majorize-minimize techniques. We provide several approximation methods for the loss functions considered in this paper, and show the overall algorithm's convergence. Numerical experiments on various learning tasks and data anomaly settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in minimizing the impact of undesirable data points compared to benchmark methods.

classification.tldr: 提出联合优化模型参数与稀疏样本权重的交替最小化框架，理论证明收敛并有效降低异常数据点的影响。

papers.title: A Nonconvex Framework for Joint Sparse Sample Weighting and Parameter Estimation

papers.abstractEn: Estimating unobserved forces in mechanistic systems is a central task of scientific machine learning. Approximate Gaussian filtering methods that synthesize mechanistic and empirical information have shown remarkable capacity in jointly identifying latent processes together with the system state in a single forward-backward pass. The resulting latent force ODE filter framework channels information from observational data specifically into the unknown parts of the system. This work addresses open questions about calibration and stability of the method. We show that the joint posterior over state and force is the reweighted conventional latent force posterior. This uncovers a crucial dependence of the stability of the method on the prior variance of the system state, which effectively controls the flow of information from observations to the latent force through the mechanistic system. From this insight, we construct an improved algorithm that provides stable and calibrated plug-and-play inference. We demonstrate the improved framework on several simulated experimental settings.

classification.tldr: 分析了潜变量力ODE滤波器的稳定性与校准条件，据此构建了稳定且校准良好的即插即用推断算法。

papers.title: Stable and Calibrated Latent Force ODE Filters

papers.abstractEn: Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. On the supply chain problem, it achieves a 0.05% mean primal gap and a 17.4$\times$ speedup over the monolithic MIP. The learned energy also generalizes to larger instances and supports zero-shot constraint injection, adapting to changing constraints without retraining while preserving feasibility.

classification.tldr: 提出学习能量函数并结合混合整数规划进行精确约束推理的框架，在多个组合优化问题上实现近优解与100%可行性。

papers.title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference

papers.abstractEn: The brain continually learns tasks with very different computational demands. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been used as dynamical surrogates for studying task solutions, with recent work extending this approach to joint training on multitask batteries. However, it remains unclear how tasks interact as these batteries grow in scale and heterogeneity: under what conditions do they transfer or interfere with one another, and how do these effects relate to task complexity and model structure? We study this question by simultaneously training hierarchical Almost-Linear RNNs (AL-RNNs) on 100 tasks spanning a wide range of cognitive demands. AL-RNNs allow us to vary the amount of nonlinearity in the recurrence, while hierarchical task features provide a low-dimensional interface for task-specific adaptation within shared dynamics. On this task battery, performance improves with both nonlinear capacity and task-feature dimensionality, with the joint hierarchical model outperforming both individually trained models and a single unstructured joint model. Many tasks are individually solvable with linear dynamics, yet cannot be solved together by a shared linear model. Through hierarchical task features, task-specific linear region usage, and task geometry, the trained model provides several related but distinct measures of task similarity that capture how computations are separated and combined within the shared backbone. Across a series of experiments, we relate these representations to individual task complexity, joint solvability, pairwise transfer learning, and leave-one-out adaptation. Together, our experiments characterize task interactions in multitask recurrent learning while demonstrating both the potential and the challenges of reusable dynamical backbones for cognitive computation.

classification.tldr: 通过在100个认知任务上联合训练分层近线性RNN，刻画多任务共享动力学中的迁移与干扰规律。

papers.title: Multitask Interactions in Recurrent Dynamics across 100 Cognitive Tasks

papers.abstractEn: Reduced-order models simplify fluid simulation by representing complex flows with a small number of spatial modes. Building on Laplacian Eigenfluids, we introduce Neural Eigenfluid Bases (NEB), a neural representation whose basis functions can be evaluated anywhere in space. We enforce incompressibility and impermeable boundaries directly through differential lifts and potential boundary conditions. Geometry-local orthogonalization and Rayleigh minimization then learn an ordered basis. We connect learning in potential and velocity spaces, and derive a spectral-variance relation explaining why these objectives weight approximate modes differently, even though their exact positive spectra agree. Gauge fixing reduces the number of spatial derivatives needed for potential learning, while a Dirichlet energy loss learns independent circulation fields around obstacles. With 1024 modes, both objectives keep velocity errors below 1% in periodic vortex merger. For random flows around obstacles, potential-based learning captures more initial energy and gives lower final errors than numerical Laplacian bases of the same size. The reduced state is about a thousand times smaller than the full reference model. Three-dimensional tests separate spatial reconstruction errors from errors in coefficient evolution. Precomputed Galerkin operators allow millisecond-scale updates when the same basis is reused across simulations. This provides a physically constrained basis for continuous flow reconstruction and efficient reduced-order simulation.

classification.tldr: 提出可任意空间求值的神经特征流体基表示，通过谱目标与规范约束学习物理一致的降阶基，实现高效流体仿真。

papers.title: Neural Eigenfluid Bases: Spectral Objectives, Gauge, and Topology

papers.abstractEn: This paper introduces a novel simulation-free framework for learning unbalanced population dynamics on the Riemannian Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) manifold, termed Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), built upon the theory of the unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB). First, by independently learning a geometry model equipped with a data-dependent metric, our model captures the intrinsic geometric structure of population dynamics. Furthermore, leveraging Doob's h-transform, the proposed method incorporates boundary information to improve flow-based trajectory inference. For unbalanced transport, a growth model is employed to learn the dynamics while constructing intermediate mass samples in the WFR space without simulation. Additionally, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed framework using a uniform Log-Sobolev inequality (LSI). Finally, we validate the proposed approach on multiple real-world datasets, demonstrating competitive performance in learning both balanced and unbalanced population dynamics compared with state-of-the-art methods.

classification.tldr: 提出基于非平衡 Schrödinger 桥的变分模拟无关框架，在 WFR 流形上学习平衡与非平衡种群动力学并给出收敛性分析。

papers.title: Learning Population Dynamics with Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow

papers.abstractEn: Autonomous vertical landing of reusable launch vehicles is a critical yet formidable challenge in aerospace engineering, primarily due to highly nonlinear dynamics, stringent precision require- ments, and inherent environmental uncertainties. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional model-based control, existing approaches frequently rely on flat training paradigms and highly simplified initial conditions, drastically limiting their real-world applicability. This paper proposes a comprehensive curriculum-driven deep reinforcement learning framework designed to master both far-range navigation and precision landing. By employing a three-stage curriculum augmented with a critic warm-up procedure and a rehearsal mechanism to prevent catastrophic forgetting, alongside a high-dimensional observation vector utilizing a full 3 X 3 rotation-matrix, the agent is trained to navigate from an initial horizontal distance of 1,000 to 1,500 units vastly farther than prior benchmarks before executing a soft touchdown. Crucially, we intro- duce a redesigned reward function that reduces unnecessary computational overhead and addresses limitations of earlier formulations, including poorly calibrated reward components and potentially conflicting optimization objectives. The redesigned function bounds the per-step reward magnitude by (O(1)), while its progress term accumulates the total distance closed over the trajectory. The available 100,000-episode results report a 99.98% success rate for the proposed policy and 68.31% for the baseline under the evaluation conditions. In the evaluation, the proposed policy retained 69.1% of its initial fuel capacity and achieved a mean final distance from the pad centre of 7.07 units, compared with 13.10 units for the baseline. Landing visualizations are available in Video 1 and Video 2.

classification.tldr: 该论文提出三阶段课程驱动的深度强化学习框架用于可重复使用火箭的远距离导航与精确着陆，配合评论家预热和防遗忘机制，成功率显著超过基线。

papers.title: Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing

papers.abstractEn: Game-theoretic feature selection scores each feature by its average marginal contribution across coalitions. An average shows whether a feature helps overall, but not whether, in some coalition, adding it turns an acceptable model into an unacceptable one. Building on minimum marginal aggregation, we define the Min-Marginal Power Index (MinPI) on a binary utility-threshold game. For a fixed quota, MinPI takes the value -1, 0, or +1 and labels each feature harmful, neutral, or decisive. A harmful label carries its own evidence, an evaluated coalition in which adding the feature drops utility below the quota, so no score cutoff is needed; finite-budget estimators keep this property but may miss harmful features. We use MinPI to propose feature removals, which are accepted only if they pass a validation gate, and to prefilter multi-objective search. On six benchmark datasets over five seeds, MinPI removed 12.5% of analyzed features with almost no loss of held-out utility. On Madelon and Abalone, where it removed the most, its removals cost far less held-out utility than random removals of the same size. Prefiltering increased the dataset-averaged hypervolume of multi-objective search in all five seeds. MinPI is therefore a conservative feature-deletion step whose gains are largest where the data contain many removable features.

classification.tldr: 提出基于博弈论最小边际聚合的特征选择指标 MinPI，可标记有害特征并在验证门控下保守删除，同时提升多目标搜索性能。

papers.title: Min-Marginal Power Indices for Multi-Objective Feature Selection

papers.abstractEn: Many supervised dimensionality reduction methods promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation but do not explicitly constrain class geometry, leading to variability in the relative arrangement of classes across independent runs. Such variability limits the reproducibility and interpretability of low-dimensional embeddings. We propose the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework in which class centroids are learned directly in the latent space while preserving a prescribed pairwise class-centroid geometry. Unlike existing centroid- or prototype-based methods that primarily encourage intra-class compactness, ICE explicitly regularizes the relative arrangement of latent class centroids. Unlike multidimensional scaling and many metric-learning approaches that preserve sample-level relationships, ICE operates on class centroids, preserving inter-class geometry without requiring large numbers of sample-pair or triplet constraints. We further show that the intrinsic dimensionality required to represent the centroid-distance configuration of $M$ classes is at most $M-1$, explaining the observed saturation of distance-preservation measures as the latent dimensionality increases. To quantify embedding reproducibility, we introduce the Centroid Neighborhood Stability (CNS) metric, which measures the consistency of class-level neighborhood topology across independent runs and complements existing embedding quality measures. Experiments on image and biological datasets demonstrate that ICE produces stable embeddings with improved preservation of class-centroid geometry while remaining computationally efficient. Additional analyses of optimization dynamics, sensitivity, and preprocessing further provide practical insights into latent dimensionality and explicit geometry modeling for supervised dimensionality reduction.

classification.tldr: 该论文提出等距质心编码器这一监督降维框架，通过显式正则化潜在类质心的相对几何提升嵌入的跨运行稳定性，并给出质心距离配置所需内在维度的理论上界。

papers.title: Stable Dimensionality Reduction via Isometric Centroid-Encoder

papers.abstractEn: Bayesian mixtures, and Solomonoff induction in particular, provide an idealized model of prediction learned by minimizing population log loss, and they underlie universal agents such as AIXI. An agent that plans with an approximation of such a predictor decides where that predictor is evaluated, and a planner can be drawn toward branches on which its model is optimistic. We study which approximation guarantees survive this feedback. For normalized finite-horizon causal mixtures, the transfer coefficient factors into a policy likelihood ratio and task evidence available before each prediction, so task rarity and action-branch rarity can compound. Within one fixed universal mixture, infinitely many computable environments admit excess prediction error of order $κη\,2^{K(μ)}$, where $η$ is the training KL budget and $κ$ measures policy coverage. This order is sharp, and for each target a computable predictor attains it at a suitable finite horizon, so computability alone does not remove the penalty. For bounded returns, value error is controlled by the probability of entering a poorly covered branch plus a square-root term in $η$. Both terms are necessary, and finite maximum coverage ratios are not required. Motivated by the mentor override of Golden Handcuffs, we derive margins for preserving deferral decisions and conditional KL budgets with an unavoidable inverse-history-probability penalty, and a counterexample separates agreement of deferral decisions from task-wise event avoidance. The guarantees apply to any predictor architecture that meets explicit population approximation and coverage conditions, which gives concrete targets for implementing idealized universal agents.

classification.tldr: 该论文从理论上分析贝叶斯混合预测器在交互规划反馈下的近似保证，刻画了任务稀有性与策略覆盖不足导致的预测误差下界及其对通用智能体实现的约束。

papers.title: Approximate Universal Prediction under Interaction

papers.abstractEn: What is the round complexity of Hessian-similar optimization when each round can contact at most $s$ of $m$ clients? Prior rates permit a free master or full participation and do not characterize strict caps. We count every one-vector query and reply. A hidden-client chain gives a lower bound for zero-respecting local algorithms with adaptive cohorts and random stopping: on strongly convex quadratics, the required rounds are $Ω((m/s)\sqrt{\min\{δ_a,\barδ/\sqrt m\}/μ}\,\log(1/ε))$ for $s\leq(m-2)/2$ in the high-accuracy, high-dissimilarity regime. Here $μ$ is strong convexity, while $δ_a$ and $\barδ$ bound anchor and average Hessian variation. To remove dependence on a poor anchor, virtual-master SVRS uses independent estimator and proximal cohorts and averages the proximal replies. With Catalyst, it reaches relative gap $ε$ in $\tilde O(m/s+(\sqrt{m/s}+m^{3/4}/s)\sqrt{\barδ/μ})$ expected rounds on quadratics with strongly convex clients, independent of $δ_a$. Combining this method with charged analyses of existing algorithms matches the lower bound's polynomial dependence for $s\leq\sqrt m$ and $s=Ω(m)$; the worst gap is $O(m^{1/8})$. A held-out 12-seed synthetic study finds fewer rounds than tuned SVRP in nine of ten dip-family incomplete-cohort cells, versus two of 30 other cells. The lower bounds concern zero-respecting algorithms and do not cover unrestricted messages.

classification.tldr: 针对每轮最多联系s个客户端的Hessian相似优化问题给出轮数下界，并提出虚拟主节点算法在二次情形达到匹配的多项式复杂度。

papers.title: Hessian-Similar Optimization with Capped Participation: Lower Bounds and Virtual Masters

papers.abstractEn: Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. End-to-end system latency was measured below 100 ms, supporting real-time responsiveness. The trained model was further used to objectively rank auditory stimuli by focus-state confidence, yielding EEG-informed audio protocols. In a paired within-subject behavioral study with 37 participants, these protocols produced a statistically significant 20 percent improvement in composite attention scores over silent controls, with a medium-to-large effect size. This work demonstrates a complete pipeline from custom EEG hardware through neural signal analysis, deep learning classification, and evidence-based auditory protocol design.

classification.tldr: 构建混合CNN-Transformer模型实时从EEG信号分类注意力状态，并据此设计听觉协议，在行为实验中显著提升注意力得分。

papers.title: EEGBiFormer: Real-Time EEG Attention Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformer with EEG-Informed Auditory Protocol Validation

papers.abstractEn: Polynomial manifolds provide nonlinear low-dimensional representations through polynomial decoders. We propose to represent the polynomial terms of the decoder using features that are orthonormal on the training data. This empirical orthogonality enables a greedy algorithm, Greedy-OPM, which jointly selects encoder modes and polynomial features while minimizing the reconstruction error under a prescribed bound on the decoder's Lipschitz constant. Numerical experiments show that this Lipschitz constraint improves generalization away from the training data while retaining high reconstruction accuracy.

classification.tldr: 该论文提出基于训练数据上正交多项式特征的贪心算法，在约束解码器Lipschitz常数的条件下联合选择编码模式与多项式特征，提升训练数据外的泛化能力。

papers.title: Greedy Orthogonal Polynomial Manifolds with Lipschitz Control for Dimensionality Reduction and Reduced Modeling

papers.abstractEn: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family's architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner's checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.

classification.tldr: 系统综述直接在单次前向中输出结构化决策的System 1模型家族，涵盖其架构、训练方法、校准理论及在Agent工作流中的快速决策应用。

papers.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS
